corpus.docs: ../corpus/papers/*.pdf (kind=paper) and ../corpus/decks/*.pdf (kind=deck). Doc-only and mixed queries assume the full corpus has been backfilled — run scripts/bench_backfill.py (or scripts/upload_doc.py per file) first.

matching.source_id_pattern: Case-insensitive SUBSTRING match against a citation's video_id OR its title. Videos use their yt_<id>; documents use a distinctive part of the uploaded filename stem, which is what register stores as the title.
matching.video_expectation: Any pattern starting with 'yt_' is a video expectation; everything else is a document expectation.
matching.locator_hint: Informational only — never scored. It tells the human doing the citation-accuracy pass where the answer actually lives.
matching.scoring: recall@10: kind=video|doc hits when >=1 expectation appears in the citations; kind=mixed hits ONLY when at least one VIDEO expectation AND at least one DOCUMENT expectation both appear (deliberately stricter — a mixed query that answers from one corpus has not proven fusion).
